title: Formalisme algébrique des correspondances et algèbres de Poincaré-Hodge (cf conjectures standard) : notes manuscrites (s.d.), tapuscrit annoté (s.d.), lettres (1966-1967).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (from the surrounding pages). M = ⊕_{0≤i≤2n} M^i is a graded module, a 'Poincaré–Hodge algebra' abstracting the cohomology of a smooth projective variety of dimension n. It carries:
- a Lefschetz operator L of degree 2 satisfying hard Lefschetz, L^{n-i}: M^i ≅ M^{2n-i};
- a subalgebra Σ of End(M), the abstract 'algebraic correspondences', containing 1 and L;
- the Künneth projectors π_i onto M^i;
- the projectors π_{i,α} onto the summand L^α P^{i-2α} of the primitive (Lefschetz) decomposition M^i = ⊕_α L^α P^{i-2α};
- the inverse Lefschetz operator Λ of degree −2.

The theorem on the previous page says the following are equivalent:
- (i) π_i ∈ Σ, and for each i there is w_i ∈ Σ inverting L^{n-i}: M^i → M^{2n-i};
- (iii) Λ ∈ Σ, which is the abstract Lefschetz standard conjecture B.
These conditions further imply (iv): all π_{i,α} ∈ Σ.

This page proves (iv) from (i) by a double induction.
- Outer induction, ascending on i ≤ n: assume (6.7) π_{jα} ∈ Σ for j ∉ [i, 2n−i]. Prove (6.7') for j = i and j = 2n−i.
- Inner induction, descending on α: assume (6.8) π_{i,α'}, π_{2n−i,α'} ∈ Σ for all α' > α. Deduce (6.8') π_{i,α}, π_{2n−i,α} ∈ Σ.
- A struck passage starts the induction (π_{iα} = 0 for α large). It also treats α = 0 via π_{i0} = π_i − Σ_{α≥1} π_{iα}; this was later found unnecessary.
- Key device: q_{i,α} = 1 − Σ_{α'>α} π_{i,α'}, which is in Σ by (6.8). On M^i it is Σ_{α'≤α} π_{i,α'}.

The next page completes the argument.
- L^{n-i+α} q_{iα} kills L^{α'}P^{i-2α'} for α' < α. This is because L^{n-i+α+α'} exceeds the nilpotency index n−(i−2α')+1 of L on P^{i-2α'}.
- On L^α P^{i-2α} it acts as the isomorphism L^{n-i+2α} onto M^{2n-i+2α}.
- Hence π_{iα} = L^α w_{i-2α} L^{n-i+α} q_{iα} ∈ Σ.
- The degree 2n−i case follows from π_{2n−i,α} = L^{n-i} π_{iα} w_i.

Purpose: to show that inside an abstract 'algebra of correspondences', the Lefschetz standard conjecture forces algebraicity of the whole Lefschetz-decomposition apparatus (Λ and the primitive projectors). This is part of the abstract formalism behind Grothendieck's standard conjectures.
errors: The displayed equality 1 − Σ_{α'>α} π_{i,α'} = Σ_{α'≤α} π_{i,α} holds only after restriction to M^i (i.e. composed with π_i). Globally, 1 = Σ_j π_j, so the two sides differ by the projectors onto the other degrees. This is harmless in the next-page formula if w_{i-2α} is extended by zero outside M^{2n-i+2α}.
The second sum should read π_{i,α'} (index α'), not π_{i,α}; this is a slip of the pen.

The outer induction hypothesis (6.7) is not actually used by the inner argument. The descending induction on α within fixed i only needs π_{i,α'} for α' > α, w_j and L. The outer induction is superfluous, not wrong.
Starting the induction at α = 0 separately (struck passage) is unnecessary: the general formula covers α = 0. Grothendieck apparently noticed this and struck it.

ideas.what: Abstract framework: graded module with Lefschetz operator and a subalgebra Σ of 'algebraic' endomorphisms; showing the primitive-decomposition projectors π_{i,α} lie in Σ once the inverses w_i of L^{n-i} and the π_i do.
ideas.modern_name: Lefschetz standard conjecture B implies algebraicity of Λ, the Hodge * operator and the Lefschetz/primitive projectors
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Standard conjectures on algebraic cycles, Bombay 1968/1969); Kleiman (Algebraic cycles and the Weil conjectures, 1968; The standard conjectures, 1994)
ideas.where_published: Grothendieck, 'Standard conjectures on algebraic cycles' (1969) states the equivalences and consequences; proofs are detailed in Kleiman 1968 (Dix exposés).

ideas.what: Explicit formula π_{iα} = L^α w_{i-2α} L^{n-i+α}(1 − Σ_{α'>α} π_{iα'}), proved by descending induction on α.
ideas.modern_name: Recursive expression of the Lefschetz-decomposition projectors as polynomials in L, the inverses of L^k, and the Künneth projectors
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard sl_2/Lefschetz linear algebra; in the algebraic-cycle setting Kleiman 1968
ideas.where_published: Not in this explicit form in Grothendieck's published texts as far as I know; equivalent statements are in Kleiman 1968.

ideas.what: Formula π_{2n−i,α} = L^{n-i} π_{iα} w_i transporting projectors through hard Lefschetz.
ideas.modern_name: Conjugation of decomposition projectors by the Lefschetz isomorphism

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine linear-algebra induction proving a known consequence of the Lefschetz standard conjecture (algebraicity of the primitive projectors), which Kleiman wrote up in 1968. The axiomatic 'Poincaré–Hodge algebra' packaging is of mild historical interest, but nothing on this page is mathematically new or absent from the literature.
transcription_corrections: Line 3 reads 'où i ≤ n' (the ≤ is written over another symbol).

After 'ce qui prouvera (iv)' the inserted phrase is 'par récurrence ascendante sur i ≤ n'. The following words look like 'Pour prouver 6.8' (likely meaning (6.7')/(6.8')) rather than 'Nous prouverons 6.8'.
The line 'par récurrence descendante sur α' is crossed out and rewritten as 'on prouve par récurrence descendante sur α,'. The next line reads 'en supposant que' (not 'supposons').
In the definition of q_{i,α}, the second sum is written Σ_{α'≤α} π_{i,α}; it should mathematically be π_{i,α'}.
The last line reads 'donc grâce à (6.8) on a q_{iα} ∈ Σ'.
The passage from 'Cela prouvera bien (6.7')' through 'il suffit de regarder le cas α ≥ 1' is struck with diagonal strokes, as the transcription indicates.
